title: Team Annihilation/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Teshin: "Out there exist an enemy that can be struck down, incapacitated, dismantled and yet they rise to fight again. Annihilate the opposing team's Oro to claim a true victory."
- Teshin: "Team Sun has absorbed the most Oro."
- Teshin: "The lead belongs to Team Sun."
- Teshin: "The Annihilation belongs to Team Sun."
- Teshin: "Team Moon has seized the lead."
- Teshin: "Team Moon has annihilated more Oro than Sun."
- Teshin: "Team Sun needs five more Oro to win."
- Teshin: "Team Sun only needs to annihilate five Oro to capture the match."
- Teshin: "Sun needs five more Moon Oro to claim victory."
- Teshin: "Team Sun team is five Oro from victory."
- Teshin: "Five more annihilations until Sun has won the match."
- Teshin: "Sun team nears victory. Five more Oro."
- Teshin: "Five Sun Oro is all that separates Team Moon from victory."
- Teshin: "Victory is five Sun Oro away for Team Moon."
- Teshin: "Team Moon is within five Oro of victory."
- Teshin: "Sun has eclipsed Moon to win the match."
- Teshin: "Sun team's blazing energy annihilates Moon team."
- Teshin: "The Moon has lit the path to victory."
- Teshin: "The match belongs to Team Moon."
- Teshin: "Sun perfectly balances Moon's energy for a match draw."
- Teshin: "A draw. Moon and Sun have fought with equal skill."
- Teshin: "Match draw. Both Sun and Moon honor The Conclave with their performance."
